checks.check: [system] the four steps happen in the order the standard gives them
[system] readyState is loading, then interactive, then complete
[system] DOMContentLoaded targets the document and load targets the window
[system] DOMContentLoaded bubbles to the window, load does not bubble at all
[system] the window's listener runs after the document's own, in path order
[system] a page that builds itself on DOMContentLoaded is not inert
[system] a custom event on the window is delivered once and removal stops it
[system] the same function registered twice is registered once, and removal clears it
[system] window.onload cleared with null reads null and does not fire
[system] window.onload is a property: assignable, replaceable, and readable
[system] a job queued in DOMContentLoaded runs before load begins
[system] a listener that throws stops neither the next listener nor the next step
[system] the sequence does not run again when the same document is observed
[system] a reload and a navigation each run the whole sequence for the new document
[system] an infinite job from a lifecycle handler is interrupted and commits nothing
[system] a child frame exists and neither its script nor a lifecycle handler ran
[system] a page can neither forge the bridge nor drive a step
[system] and the four real steps still happen exactly once, in order
[system] no value shaped like the capability is in a snapshot or an audit record
[system] a connected element's bubbling event reaches the document and then the window
[system] a detached element's reaches its own ancestors and never the document or window
[system] document.parentNode is still null
[system] what a lifecycle handler mutates is in the first snapshot and the revision
[system] M1: the frozen fixture's listeners cost at most 65536 live owner bytes
[system] M2: 128 replacements stay within the one-document baseline
[system] M3: closing every target returns the owners exactly

limitations: design-frozen court: it fails until the bounded lifecycle exists
four steps of an event loop, not an event loop: no defer/async ordering, no resource load, no pageshow, beforeunload or visibility
a host that does not answer inside its wall-clock bound is killed by pid and reaped; that timeout is the falsification
one hermetic loopback origin, macOS only; no surface, no window, no AppKit
memory is judged by bounded owners and paired differentials, never an absolute footprint gate
